# Feedback Examples

弹层类组件通常使用 `open`/`update:open` 或 `open`/`onOpenChange`。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Loading

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/loading/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/loading/`.

Note: 每次 `spinning` 变为真都重新等 `delay`，中途转回假就取消。`fullscreen` 盖住视口，和有没有子节点分开，层高于模态，并占住焦点栈。区域遮罩把 `aria-busy` 放在被挡住的区域上，结束时若焦点没被移走就还回去。

Vue: `<Loading :spinning="loading"><slot /></Loading>`

React: `<Loading spinning={loading}>{children}</Loading>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
